title: The First and the Last Words
author: A. Theodore Tuttle
calling_raw: Of the First Quorum of the Seventy
notes_text: 1.  This declaration by Moroni was placed as section 1 in the Book of Commandments. After the Preface was given to the Book of Commandments on November 1, 1831, this revelation was then made section 2. Today it is found as section 2 in the Doctrine and Covenants.
